title: Emancipation Proclamation
description:
President Abraham Lincoln issued the **Emancipation Proclamation** on January 1, 1863, declaring all enslaved people in Confederate states to be free.

While it didn't immediately free all enslaved people, it fundamentally transformed the character of the Civil War and paved the way for the 13th Amendment.

The proclamation allowed Black men to serve in the Union Army and Navy.
